strategies.name: ict_aplus_entry_checklist

entry_sequence.action: once I have a daily bias or Direction I will use this checklist to make sure all requirements are met before I take an entry
entry_sequence.note: PRECONDITION — the checklist is only applied after a daily bias / direction is already established

entry_sequence.action: the first thing I focus on is a stop raid this just means that a low was put in before it was rated or broken
the next thing I look for is a market structure shift or displacement this means that a previous high was broken and aggressively moved over
I generally like to see price move back into a discount of this price range here
entry_sequence.note: the next thing I look for is where there is a little bit flexibility; I'm not looking too long Above This 0.5, I'd want to be longing this green section down here

entry_sequence.action: taking that one step further by using an OTE I can see that this is our premium up here where I do not want to be longing and this Narrows down my discount range to my OTE right in here
some sort of PD array where generally I prefer to have a fair value gut or an order block but I will also use an OTE in this area as well as a breaker block
entry_sequence.note: an order block which would be this down close candle right here and then breaker block would be these up close candles here before the raid on liquidity

entry_sequence.action: for my entry I would personally be looking to enter the trade right here
entry_sequence.note: enter at the chosen PD array; also 'my entry would be on this order block' and 'from here we have order block fair value Gap so I would be looking to enter here'

confluences.description: each one of these Concepts could be used as an entry model by themselves however I like to blend one two or three of these Concepts together
confluences.note: for example: I will look for a fair value Gap in an optimal trade entry or I'll look for the box set up in an optimal trade entry

confluences.description: I prefer to have a stop rate prior to the displacement so I am not counting this as a displacement move up
confluences.note: sequencing filter — a displacement with no prior lower-timeframe liquidity raid is rejected: 'without a lower time frame liquidity rate prior to a move I am not interested in it'

confluences.description: does that meet all my criteria it does not because it is in a premium of the range
confluences.note: discount/premium filter on the PD array — reject a PD array (e.g. an FVG) that sits in the premium of the range for a long

confluences.description: as I move my entry closer to my stop loss my risk to reward increases however the further I go there is also the possibility that I do not get filled on this trade
confluences.note: entry-selection by risk-to-reward — balance R:R against getting filled

confluences.description: we did go a tick below this low but I do not count that personally
confluences.note: occurrence tolerance — a single tick beyond the low is not counted as invalidating the level

strategies.stop: putting my stop on this order block low (order-block LOW for a long); my stop on the order block High (order-block HIGH for a short); or My Stop on this low (on the swept structure low)

targets.description: looking for buy side liquidity up here

targets.note: a new low / sell-side for shorts
the other side of the range for the box setup

targets.description: your target the initial highs from the morning
targets.note: let runners run: 'partial or move my stop to break even your target the initial highs from the morning and from there let runners run'

strategies.management: first partial here, then depending on if I move my stop to break even, then let runners run to the further liquidity — 'partial or move my stop to break even your target the initial highs from the morning and from there let runners run'

variants.variant_label: Blended PD-array A+ entry (FVG / order block / breaker / OTE, discount return after stop-raid + MSS)
variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: stop raid -> market-structure shift/displacement -> return into discount (OTE-refined) -> PD array (FVG/OB/breaker/OTE), blend 1-3
variants.target_note: opposite-side liquidity (buy-side above / new low / initial highs from the morning), first partial then break-even then runners
variants.transcript_quote: I will look for a fair value Gap in an optimal trade entry or I'll look for the box set up in an optimal trade entry

variants.variant_label: Box setup (deviation/manipulation -> retest -> other side; no structure shift required)
variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: deviation/manipulation out of range (aggressive down then up) -> retest of the manipulation -> reach for the other side
variants.target_note: the other side of the range / liquidity resting above
variants.transcript_quote: this is the deviation from the range and so accumulation manipulation I want to see distribution so ideally I'm looking for a retest of this manipulation to then be reaching for the other side

instrument_classification.session: intraday / day-trading (targets 'the initial highs from the morning')
instrument_classification.rationale: ICT price-action mechanic (stop raid, market-structure shift/displacement, discount/premium, PD arrays: FVG/order block/breaker/OTE). Demonstrated on NASDAQ and ES index futures across intraday timeframes but the logic is instrument-agnostic and not options-specific (no strikes/Greeks).

coaching_notes: if you want to pause and see what you see go ahead and do that
I just do what catches my eye the most
so what I try to do is find a balance between risk to reward what catches my eye and just getting into the trade
I wanted to throw it in here just to show that without a lower time frame liquidity rate prior to a move I am not interested in it
